inputs.text: Police activity: possible armed domestic situation at the 3600 block of West Broadway, Robbinsdale; three people detained, information on additional suspects. Residents of the 3600-3700 block of Hubbard and West Broadway should shelter in place until about 10 to 10:30 pm (police said 10 pm, the Sheriff's Office about 10:30 pm, per the press).

requested_area.areaDesc: 3600-3700 block of Hubbard and West Broadway, Robbinsdale, Minnesota

fields.description: Police activity: possible armed domestic situation, 3600 block of West Broadway, Robbinsdale. Three people detained; police have information on more suspects. Residents of the 3600-3700 block of Hubbard and West Broadway: shelter in place until about 10:30 pm.
fields.headline: Shelter in place: police activity near 3600 block of West Broadway, Robbinsdale
fields.instruction: Stay inside, lock doors and keep away from windows. Do not go outside until officials say it is safe.
left_out: The police's stated end time of 10 pm: it conflicts with the Sheriff's Office estimate of about 10:30 pm, both reported via the press. I used the Sheriff's Office time because it is the issuer's own and the more cautious of the two.
fields.note_for_reviewer: The input gives two end times reported via the press (10 pm from police, about 10:30 pm from the Sheriff's Office). Please confirm the current shelter end time. I set certainty to Likely, not Observed, because the armed element is described only as 'possible'.
